title: Chemical Drain Cleaners vs Mechanical Pipe Clearing
description: Many homeowners and maintenance workers rely on store-bought chemical drain cleaners to clear stubborn drainage blockages. However, aggressive chemical cleaners can cause severe damage to modern PVC and older metal piping systems. Caustic solutions generate intense heat through chemical reactions that can soften, warp, or crack plastic pipes and corrode metal joints. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the obstruction, it leaves a basin or pipe full of toxic liquid that poses safety risks to technicians performing mechanical snaking. Professional drainage maintenance relies on mechanical augers, drain snakes, or hydro-jetting to safely restore full pipe flow.
